Le géant des télécoms Ooredoo Algérie a: Telecom giant Ooredoo Algeria has announced a network infrastructure modernization operation scheduled for June 2, 2026, between midnight and six in the morning, an initiative aimed at strengthening service quality and preparing for the arrival of new technologies.
Dans un communiqué officiel, Ooredoo Alg: In an official press release, Ooredoo Algeria revealed its intention to carry out a complete network upgrade on June 2, 2026, between 00:00 and 06:00. This operation, while likely to cause temporary disruptions, is part of a continuous improvement approach for user coverage and performance.
En Algérie, le secteur des télécoms est: In Algeria, the telecom sector is marked by intense competition among the three historical operators: Mobilis (Algérie Télécom), Djezzy (Orascom Telecom Algérie), and Ooredoo. Each of these players is investing heavily in the expansion and modernization of its infrastructure to meet growing data demand, particularly with the rise of 4G services and the preparation of 5G networks.
Ooredoo, qui a récemment renforcé sa pos: Ooredoo, which recently strengthened its position with aggressive offers and technological partnerships, is relying on this upgrade to consolidate its coverage and improve latency, a crucial issue for business and residential users.
La période choisie, en pleine nuit, vise: The period chosen, in the middle of the night, aims to limit the impact on users, a common practice in the sector. Ooredoo's technical teams will work tirelessly to minimize disruptions while ensuring a smooth transition to a higher-performing infrastructure.
Cette opération s’ajoute à d’autres init: This operation adds to other recent initiatives, such as the deployment of 5G in certain urban areas or the optimization of 4G networks for a better user experience.
Les observateurs du secteur soulignent q: Industry observers emphasize that these upgrades are essential to keep pace with technological innovations and consumer expectations. With a rapidly changing Algerian telecom market, where mobile data represents a major economic stake, every operator must prove its capacity to innovate.
Ooredoo, qui a déjà lancé des offres com: Ooredoo, which has already launched competitive offers and digital services, appears determined to consolidate its position against its competitors, notably Djezzy, which relies on attractive pricing, and Mobilis, which benefits from the support of the Algerian state.
Pour les abonnés, cette mise à niveau es: For subscribers, this upgrade is an opportunity to benefit from a more stable and high-performing network, provided that disruptions remain limited, as the operator promises.
